```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| label: fig-funding-vs-cost-per-daly
#| fig-cap: "Cost per DALY averted as a function of annual funding level. Uses undiscounted total cost (upfront platform build + annual funding over queue clearance period) because annual government appropriations are not a discountable capital allocation. The curve is monotonically decreasing: more funding always improves efficiency, but with strongly diminishing returns."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import (
    setup_chart_style, add_watermark, clean_spines, add_png_metadata,
    get_figure_output_path, COLOR_BLACK, COLOR_WHITE
)
from dih_models.dfda_trial_economics import (
    compute_at_funding_level, compute_across_funding_levels,
    get_floor_cost_per_daly, get_floor_queue_cost, get_ceiling_dalys,
)

setup_chart_style()

# ── Parameters (only those needed for display, not computation) ────────
bed_nets = float(BED_NETS_COST_PER_DALY)
upfront_cost = float(DFDA_NPV_UPFRONT_COST_TOTAL)

# ── Computation via shared library ─────────────────────────────────────
sweep = compute_across_funding_levels()
funding_levels = sweep["funding_levels"]
cost_per_daly = sweep["cost_per_daly"]

proposed = compute_at_funding_level()  # defaults to proposed treaty funding
floor_cpd = get_floor_cost_per_daly()
floor_cost = get_floor_queue_cost()

# ── Plot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
valid = ~np.isnan(cost_per_daly)
valid_cpd = cost_per_daly[valid]
valid_funding = funding_levels[valid]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16, 11))

ax.plot(valid_funding / 1e9, valid_cpd,
        linewidth=3.5, color=COLOR_BLACK, linestyle='-')

# Reference line: bed nets ($89/DALY)
ax.axhline(y=bed_nets, color=COLOR_BLACK, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.6)
ax.text(valid_funding[-1] / 1e9 * 0.7, bed_nets,
        f'Bed Nets (${bed_nets:.0f}/DALY)',
        fontsize=20, color=COLOR_BLACK, ha='right', va='center',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
                  edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=1))

# Asymptotic floor line
ax.axhline(y=floor_cpd, color=COLOR_BLACK, linestyle=':', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.5)
ax.text(0.97, 0.08,
        f'Asymptotic floor: ${floor_cpd:.2f}/DALY\n'
        f'(total queue cost ~${floor_cost/1e9:.0f}B is roughly\n'
        f'fixed regardless of funding level)',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=18, color=COLOR_BLACK, va='bottom', ha='right',
        style='italic',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
                  edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=1, alpha=0.9))

# Mark proposed funding
pf = proposed["funding"]
proposed_cpd = proposed["cost_per_daly"]
proposed_clearance = proposed["clearance_years"]
proposed_multiplier = proposed["multiplier"]
proposed_total_shift = proposed["total_shift"]
proposed_dalys = proposed["dalys_averted"]
proposed_total_cost = proposed["total_cost"]

ax.plot(pf / 1e9, proposed_cpd,
        marker='o', markersize=14, color=COLOR_BLACK, zorder=5)
ax.annotate(
    f'Proposed Treaty: ${proposed_cpd:.2f}/DALY\n'
    f'${pf/1e9:.1f}B/yr x {proposed_clearance:.0f} yrs = ${proposed_total_cost/1e9:.0f}B total\n'
    f'{proposed_multiplier:.1f}x capacity, {proposed_total_shift:.0f}-yr treatment shift\n'
    f'= ${proposed_total_cost/1e9:.0f}B / {proposed_dalys/1e9:.0f}B DALYs',
    xy=(pf / 1e9, proposed_cpd),
    xytext=(0.50, 0.72), textcoords='axes fraction',
    fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_BLACK,
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.5', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
              edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=2.5),
    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=2.5))

# Causal explanation annotations
ax.text(0.03, 0.92,
        'Low funding: capacity barely\nexceeds status quo, so\nacceleration is near zero\n(but you still pay for the\nfull queue over centuries)',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=18, color=COLOR_BLACK, va='top', ha='left',
        style='italic',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
                  edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=1, alpha=0.9))

ax.text(0.97, 0.42,
        'Curve flattens: total cost is\nroughly fixed (~$785B to clear\nthe queue). Only speed changes.\nMore funding = more DALYs\naverted = lower cost/DALY.',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=18, color=COLOR_BLACK, va='top', ha='right',
        style='italic',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.4', facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
                  edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK, linewidth=1, alpha=0.9))

# Axes
ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_xlabel('Annual Funding Level ($B)', fontsize=22, fontweight='bold', color=COLOR_BLACK)
ax.set_ylabel('Cost per DALY Averted (USD)', fontsize=22, fontweight='bold',
              color=COLOR_BLACK)
ax.set_title('Cost per DALY vs. Funding Level',
             fontsize=28, fontweight='bold', pad=30, color=COLOR_BLACK)
ax.text(0.5, 1.01,
        f'Undiscounted total cost (${upfront_cost/1e6:.0f}M upfront + annual funding x queue clearance years).',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=18, color=COLOR_BLACK, ha='center', va='bottom')

ax.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=18)

# Format x-axis ticks as dollar amounts
from matplotlib.ticker import FuncFormatter
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda x, _: f'${x:.0f}B' if x >= 1 else f'${x*1000:.0f}M'))
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FuncFormatter(lambda y, _: f'${y:,.0f}' if y >= 1 else f'${y:.2f}'))

clean_spines(ax)
add_watermark(fig)

output_path = get_figure_output_path('funding-vs-cost-per-daly-line-chart.png')
plt.savefig(output_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.3, facecolor=COLOR_WHITE)
add_png_metadata(
    output_path,
    title="Cost per DALY vs. Funding Level",
    description="Shows how cost per DALY averted varies with funding level. Uses undiscounted total cost because annual government appropriations are not a discountable capital allocation. Total queue clearance cost is roughly fixed (~$785B); more funding buys speed and more DALYs averted."
)
plt.show()

# Print verification
print(f"\nVerification at proposed funding (${pf/1e9:.1f}B/yr):")
print(f"  Trial capacity multiplier: {proposed_multiplier:.1f}x")
print(f"  Queue clearance: {proposed_clearance:.1f} years")
print(f"  Treatment acceleration: {proposed['accel_years']:.1f} years")
print(f"  Total timeline shift: {proposed_total_shift:.1f} years")
print(f"  DALYs averted: {proposed_dalys/1e9:.1f}B")
print(f"  Upfront cost: ${upfront_cost/1e6:.0f}M")
print(f"  Total undiscounted cost: ${proposed_total_cost/1e9:.1f}B")
print(f"  Cost per DALY: ${proposed_cpd:.2f}")
print(f"  Asymptotic floor: ${floor_cpd:.2f}/DALY (total queue cost: ${floor_cost/1e9:.0f}B)")
```
